name: Nóráp (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and yellow in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nóráp: a white shield with an angel and a green base, between ears of grain, with a blue scroll inscribed NÓRÁP.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nóráp arms with grain and scroll
